notes: Quantities are per ONE standard adult portion and the app scales them. {{300|ml}} in a step is scaled too. Steps assume a confident home cook. Every ingredient has an amount except salt and pepper (to taste). Run tools/check_recipes.py after editing.

recipes.name: Red lentil & spinach dhal
recipes.blurb: Cheap, warming and properly filling with yoghurt and chapatis.

steps.t: Soften the chopped onion in the oil over a medium heat, about 8 minutes. Add the crushed garlic, grated ginger, cumin and turmeric and stir for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and {{300|ml}} water. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils have collapsed and it's thick. Loosen with a splash of water if it catches.
Spoon the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt. Stir a little spinach into it to wilt.
Stir the spinach, garam masala and chilli flakes into the rest until wilted. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with yoghurt and warm chapatis.

baby.smooth: Blend or mash until smooth and loosen with their usual milk. Serve with a little plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Keep it thick and let it cool to warm. Chapati or toast fingers to scoop with, plus a spoon of plain yoghurt.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, with small pieces of chapati.

recipes.name: Black bean & sweet potato chilli
recipes.blurb: Smoky beans and sweet potato with rice, cheese and yoghurt.

steps.t: Fry the chopped onion, pepper and sweet potato (1.5 cm cubes) in the oil over a medium heat for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and oregano and stir for 1 minute.
Add the drained beans, tomatoes and {{100|ml}} water. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender. Cook the rice meanwhile.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Stir in the chilli flakes and season with salt. Serve over rice with grated cheddar and a spoon of yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Mash the beans and sweet potato smooth with a little yoghurt.
baby.finger: Lightly squashed beans, soft sweet potato cubes to pick up, sticky rice and a pinch of cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: Tofu & broccoli peanut noodles
recipes.blurb: Crispy tofu, broccoli and noodles in a quick satay-style sauce. No coconut.

steps.t: Pat the tofu dry, cut into fingers and fry in the oil over a medium-high heat until golden on most sides, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the noodles, adding the broccoli and edamame for the last 3 minutes. Drain, keeping a mugful of the water.
Whisk the peanut butter with the crushed garlic, grated ginger, lime juice and a splash of noodle water until smooth and pourable.
Take the baby's portion out now: tofu fingers, soft broccoli and short noodles with a little sauce, before the soy and chilli.
Stir the soy sauce and chilli flakes into the rest of the sauce, then toss with the noodles, veg and tofu.

baby.smooth: Blend broccoli and a little tofu with a teaspoon of the peanut sauce and some water.
baby.finger: Tofu fingers, soft broccoli florets, squashed edamame and short noodles. If peanut is new to them, try it earlier in the day first.
baby.chopped: As yours before the soy and chilli, chopped small.

recipes.name: Lentil & mushroom bolognese
recipes.blurb: The family classic, with lentils and mushrooms instead of mince.

steps.t: Finely chop the onion, carrot and mushrooms (a food processor does it in seconds). Fry in the oil over a medium heat for 10 minutes until soft and starting to brown.
Stir in the garlic, tomato purée and oregano for 1 minute. Add the drained lentils, tomatoes and {{75|ml}} water and simmer for 15 minutes while the pasta cooks.
Take the baby's sauce and pasta out now, before the Henderson's and seasoning.
Season the rest with Henderson's, salt and pepper. Toss with the pasta and grate the cheese over.

baby.smooth: Blend the sauce with a few pieces of soft pasta.
baby.finger: Big pasta shapes like fusilli, cooked soft and coated in sauce, with a little grated cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours before seasoning, with the pasta cut small.

recipes.name: Paneer & pea curry
recipes.blurb: Mild tomato curry with golden paneer and peas. No cream or coconut.

steps.t: Fry the paneer cubes in the oil over a high heat until golden on a few sides, about 4 minutes. Lift out and set aside. Start the rice.

Soften the chopped onion in the same pan over a medium heat for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, grated ginger, cumin, ground coriander and turmeric for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and {{75|ml}} water. Simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the peas and paneer and simmer for 3 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in the yoghurt (off the heat so it doesn't split).
Take the baby's portion out now, before the garam masala, chilli and salt.
Stir the garam masala and chilli flakes into the rest and season with salt. Scatter over the coriander and serve with the rice.

baby.smooth: Blend the sauce with the peas and a little paneer.
baby.finger: Paneer fingers, squashed peas, and rice they can grab in clumps.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, paneer chopped small.

recipes.name: Chickpea shakshuka with feta
recipes.blurb: Eggs baked in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce, with bread to dunk.

steps.t: Fry the sliced onion and pepper in the oil in a wide frying pan with a lid, over a medium heat, until soft, about 10 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained chickpeas and simmer for 8 minutes until thick enough to hold a hollow.
Spoon the baby's sauce into a small pan, crack in one egg, cover and cook on a low heat until the egg is fully set, about 8 minutes. Do this before any salt, chilli or feta goes in.

Season the rest with salt and chilli flakes. Make hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on a low heat for 5 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still soft. Crumble over the feta and serve with the bread.

baby.smooth: Cook their egg until firm and mash it into blended sauce.
baby.finger: Their egg cooked until fully set, in strips, with squashed chickpeas and bread fingers to dip. No feta: it's salty.
baby.chopped: As yours, egg cooked through, no feta.

recipes.name: Smoky chickpea & halloumi traybake
recipes.blurb: One tray of roast veg, chickpeas and halloumi with tahini yoghurt.

steps.t: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Toss the chunky-chopped onion, courgette and pepper and the drained chickpeas with the oil, smoked paprika and cumin on a large tray. Roast for 20 minutes.
Take the baby's veg and chickpeas off the tray now, before the salt and halloumi.
Season the tray with salt, add the sliced halloumi and the tomatoes, and roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the halloumi is golden.
Mix the yoghurt with the tahini, lemon juice and a splash of water. Serve with warm flatbreads.

baby.smooth: Mash the roast veg and chickpeas with plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Soft roast pepper and courgette strips, squashed chickpeas, quartered cherry tomatoes, flatbread fingers and plain yoghurt. No halloumi: it's very salty.
baby.chopped: As yours, with a little halloumi at most.

recipes.name: Mushroom & lentil cottage pie
recipes.blurb: A weekend bake. Make a big one; it reheats brilliantly.

steps.t: Boil the potatoes (no need to peel, just scrub and chunk) for 15 to 18 minutes until soft. Drain and mash with the milk and butter. Heat the oven to 200°C fan.

Meanwhile fry the chopped onion, carrot and mushrooms in the oil over a medium heat for 10 minutes. Stir in the tomato purée and herbs, then the drained lentils and {{100|ml}} water. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon some filling and mash into a small dish for the baby now, before the stock and seasoning.
Crumble the stock cube into the rest with the Henderson's, salt and pepper. Tip into a baking dish, top with the mash and cheese and bake for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with peas.

baby.smooth: Mash the filling and potato together until smooth.
baby.finger: Soft forkfuls of filling and mash, with squashed peas.
baby.chopped: As yours before the stock, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: Pesto pasta with Quorn & spinach
recipes.blurb: A ten-minute rescue dinner from the freezer and cupboard.

steps.t: Boil the pasta. Add the frozen Quorn pieces and peas for the last 5 minutes.
Drain, keeping a splash of water, and stir the spinach through so it wilts.
Take the baby's portion out now, with only a little pesto (it's salty and contains nuts).
Stir the pesto and a splash of pasta water through the rest.

baby.smooth: Blend pasta, peas and spinach with a little water and a tiny bit of pesto.
baby.finger: Big pasta shapes, Quorn cut into small strips, squashed peas. If tree nuts are new to them, try pesto earlier in the day first.
baby.chopped: As yours with the Quorn chopped small and only a little pesto.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with peas & edamame
recipes.blurb: Microwave rice, frozen veg and eggs. On the table in 12 minutes.

steps.t: Fry the garlic in the oil in a large pan or wok for 30 seconds. Add the frozen peas and edamame and cook for 3 minutes.
Squeeze the rice pouches to break the grains up, add to the pan and stir-fry for 3 minutes until hot.
Push the rice aside, scramble the beaten eggs in the gap, then stir through.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the soy sauce.
Season the rest with the soy sauce.

baby.smooth: Blend rice, peas and egg with a little water.
baby.finger: Clumps of rice, strips of well-cooked egg, squashed peas and edamame.
baby.chopped: As yours, before the soy sauce.

recipes.name: Cheesy beans on toast with an egg
recipes.blurb: The classic emergency dinner, with enough protein to count.

steps.t: Warm the beans. Toast and butter the bread. Fry the eggs in the oil.
Take the baby's portion out now: toast fingers, a spoon of mashed beans and an egg cooked until set.
Pile the beans on the toast, grate the cheese over and top with the eggs.

baby.smooth: Mash a few beans with soft-cooked egg.
baby.finger: Toast fingers, a small spoon of mashed reduced-salt beans, and egg cooked through, in strips. Go easy on the cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours, cut small, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: 15-minute chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.blurb: Tins, frozen spinach and the spice rack. No curry paste, so no hidden coconut.

steps.t: Fry the garlic, cumin and turmeric in the oil for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, drained chickpeas and frozen spinach.
Simmer for 8 minutes, squashing some chickpeas to thicken it. Heat the rice meanwhile.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the garam masala, chilli and salt.
Stir the garam masala and chilli flakes into the rest and season with salt. Serve with rice and a spoon of yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Blend with a spoon of yoghurt until smooth.
baby.finger: Squashed chickpeas and spinach to scoop with rice, plus plain yoghurt.
baby.chopped: As yours, before the chilli and salt.

recipes.name: Bean & cheese quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp wraps with smoky beans and melted cheese. Great for little hands.

steps.t: Mash the drained beans with the smoked paprika and cumin.
Make the baby's quesadilla first: a thin layer of beans and a little cheese in half a wrap, no chilli.
Stir the chilli flakes into the rest of the beans. Spread over half of each wrap, add the cheese and fold.
Dry-fry in a frying pan over a medium heat for 2 minutes a side until crisp. Cut into wedges and serve with the yoghurt.

baby.finger: Quesadilla cut into strips once cooled, with yoghurt to dip.
baby.chopped: Small wedges of yours without the chilli.
